messages:
Marta: Quick recap from this morning's canary: ~0.4% of hosts served the previous epoch after we activated the new rollout. Looks like a resolver/store snapshot race.

Alex: Do you have a minimal log? Trying to confirm whether apply or store is the lag.

Marta: snippet: `host-11: restore pin model=redwood/core epoch=88; rollout.activate(epoch=90) @+11s; served epoch=88 @+19s`

Simon: Agreed resolver race. Proposal: add transition_epoch + grace_ms + dry_run to rollout metadata. dry_run causes hosts to emit `pin_would_evict` without changing behavior.

Jules: Also add `eviction_policy` enum (soft|immediate|deferred) and `debounce_ms` to avoid thrash on rollbacks.

Nora: Naming preference: `transition_epoch` + `grace_ms` is clear. Also require `rollout_token` for provenance in the migration.

Alex: Compatibility: add `compat_version` so older runtimes ignore transition_epoch. SDK/deploy tool to set that. Also support `dry_run=true` in the tool.

Marta: Migration plan: 1) ship telemetry (pin_seen_epoch, pin_would_evict, pin_evicted_epoch); 2) run dry_run rollout for 48h and verify <=0.5% lag; 3) enable enforcement with grace_ms and debounce.

Simon: Edge-case: if we flip back-and-forth, hosts that evicted may re-request. Enforce per-host debounce and require `force`/`eviction_policy=immediate` to override.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-1402: rollout schema extension + telemetry. See PR feat/rollout-schema (pr-8421).

Marta: I'll update the RFC with the fields and the staged rollout checklist. Thanks everyone.
notes: action items: Marta update RFC; Alex update SDK/deploy tool; Simon add telemetry & dashboard; Jules define eviction_policy enum; Nora draft migration runbook; Ops run dry_run and collect 48h data.
